# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# pyjwt: semgrep pins pyjwt[crypto]~=2.13.0 (1.177.0 and 1.178.0 alike), and every
# 2.13.x is affected by GHSA-w6j9-cwv2-h6wq and ten more advisories fixed in 2.14.0, and
# 2.14.0 itself by GHSA-42vr-xj54-vc7v, fixed in 2.15.0. 2.15.0 changes only PyJWKClient
# and JWKSetCache behaviour, and semgrep imports jwt only
# in its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`, which is all semgrep.yaml runs.
# semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps so pip does not re-apply semgrep's pin. Delete
# this line once a semgrep release allows pyjwt 2.15.
pyjwt[crypto]~=2.15.0

# semgrep pins wcmatch~=8.3 (still true of 1.187.0), but wcmatch <= 11.1 is affected by
# GHSA-53pm-wgxf-c6qf (polynomial-time ReDoS on multi-star patterns).
# Drop this override once a semgrep release allows wcmatch >= 11.2.
wcmatch>=11.2
